{{Quote|Admiral Ranken to all ships: Switch to atmospheric thrusters and prepare for assault.|Admiral [[Zasha Ranken]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]''</ref>}}
'''Atmospheric thrusters''' were an augmentation to the basic [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] and [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drive]] that most [[Starship/Legends|starships]] used when flying in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. They provided extra speed and performance and helped make the starship more competitive with a dedicated [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]].
